passage:
Thursday.
Told the whole hostel table how I basically saved the fest sponsorship single-handed. Okay, Shreya made the calls. But the pitch was mine. When Shreya mentioned she'd got into the Delhi exchange programme, I said, "Oh, the easy one?" She went quiet. Good.
Then in seminar, Prof said my paper was "thin on sources", in front of everyone. I didn't speak to anyone for the rest of the day and skipped dinner. I'm furious. What does she know.
Now it's 1 a.m. and I keep thinking: if I'm not the best one in the room, what am I? I hate that question. Not writing any more tonight.
Deepika

qa.q: What did Prof say about Deepika's paper?
qa.a: Prof said it was "thin on sources".

qa.q: What does Deepika's 1 a.m. question suggest about how Deepika feels inside?
qa.a: It suggests that under the big stories, Deepika's sense of self is shaky and depends on being the best.

qa.q: What choice did Deepika make after the criticism, and what did it cost?
qa.a: Deepika went silent all day and skipped dinner, which kept the anger going instead of using the feedback.

qa.q: How might Shreya feel after "Oh, the easy one?"
qa.a: She was probably hurt and deflated, which shows in how she went quiet.

grounding: A diary shows a young adult who casts themselves as the hero, dismisses a friend's success and goes cold at criticism, with a shaky self-image underneath.

Zainab: guys I got the museum internship!!
Jahnavi: nice. I turned that one down last year actually
Zainab: oh I didn't know you applied
Jahnavi: they basically begged me. I had better offers
Zainab: ok well I'm excited anyway
Jahnavi: you should be, it's a good starter one
Zainab: also, quick thing about your slides for tomorrow
Zainab: slide 6 has the wrong dates for the exhibition
Jahnavi: wow. ok.
Jahnavi: I didn't ask for a review
Zainab: I just meant so you don't lose marks
Jahnavi: I've presented to actual directors, I think I know my slides
Jahnavi left the group
Zainab: I really was only trying to help

qa.q: Which slide had the wrong dates?
qa.a: Slide 6 had the wrong dates for the exhibition.

qa.q: What might Jahnavi be feeling when Zainab points out the wrong dates?
qa.a: Jahnavi seems stung and angry, as if any correction threatens Jahnavi's image, which is why Jahnavi leaves the group.

qa.q: What choice did Jahnavi make when corrected, and what did it cost?
qa.a: Jahnavi snapped and left the group, pushing away a friend who was trying to save marks for tomorrow.

qa.q: How might Zainab feel after being told the internship is "a good starter one"?
qa.a: Zainab may feel belittled, as if the good news had been made smaller.

grounding: A chat shows a young adult shrinking a friend's achievement, casting themselves as superior and reacting coldly to a small correction.
